about: Measurable rules Mann's QC enforces. When the owner corrects an edit, /studio-learn records the rule in studio/LEARNINGS.md (Editor) and, if it is measurable, tightens a threshold here and adds a history entry. Newest owner rule wins.

history.source: director edit-for-retention rules (visual change every 1.5-3 s in Shorts, no dead air over 1 s)
Mann v1 defaults; change only from owner feedback or real results

history.rule: craft rules (captions, safe zone, typography, contrast, cuts, flashes, music under voice)
history.source: owner asked Mann to learn and harness the craft rulebook; values from SMPTE ST 2046-1, Netflix timed-text guides, WCAG 2.x, or labelled defaults

history.rule: takes (silence floor, guard, laugh, retakes, fillers, aggressive/documentary gap rows)
history.value: F = p10 of 0.5 s RMS, threshold F+6 dB, guard S-F < 8 dB, laugh F+10 dB, 3-gram > 0.8 within 3 s, 4-gram > 0.7 within 60 s, fillers 50 ms pad
history.source: external calibration from louisedesadeleer/cut-video SKILL.md (MIT, a5a87a6) via projects/editor-repos/re/SPEC.md; not owner

history.rule: takes (island pause, word pads, balanced inner-pause shrink, subcheck, frame snap)
history.value: islands split at 0.3 s, in -0.12 s, out +0.25 s, pauses > 0.26 s -> 0.18 s
history.source: external calibration from kurbaitaev/ghost-editor references/take-selection.md (MIT, d71bdb6) via projects/editor-repos/re/SPEC.md; not owner
